title: C# Questions & Answers - Network Errors Handling
sourceFile: Network Errors handling - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# MCQs focuses on networking errors in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: What exception is thrown if the URI format is invalid?
What exception is thrown if the protocol supported by URI prefix is invalid?
What exception is thrown if the user does not have a proper authorization?
Choose the exceptions generated by the Create() method defined by WebRequest.
Choose the exceptions generated by the GetResponse() method defined by WebRequest.
questions.explanation: WebRequest.GetResponse can throw InvalidOperationException, ProtocolViolationException, and WebException (among others).

questions.question: Select the properties related to the network errors generated by WebException:
Which of these .NET classes is used to send an HTTP request from a client to a server?
questions.explanation: HttpWebRequest (and HttpClient) send an HTTP request. HttpListener and TcpListener accept incoming connections. Dns resolves host names. httpd is not a .NET type.

questions.question: Choose the exceptions generated by the GetResponseStream() method defined by WebResponse.
questions.explanation: GetResponseStream() is on WebResponse (not WebRequest). HttpWebResponse.GetResponseStream can throw ProtocolViolationException and ObjectDisposedException; reading the stream can throw IOException.

questions.question: Which of these Uri members gives the full URI string?
questions.explanation: Uri.AbsoluteUri is the full URI. getHost() and toExternalForm() are Java URL methods, not .NET.
